item.title: Four-way stop proposal rejected by Piermont voters - Valley News
item.description: Voters in Piermont reject proposal for four-way stop, approve funding for stop signs and speed radar signs. Budget and school articles also passed.

item.description: Public outcry as SAU 6's search for a new executive director lacks transparency. Residents demand more community involvement in the selection process.

item.title: Hartford High School names Amy Molina as new principal - Valley News
item.description: Amy Molina, a dedicated educator with 25 years of experience, has been appointed as the new principal of Hartford High School.

item.title: Drought recovery in NH requires double normal rainfall - Valley News
item.description: Much of the Upper Valley faces a severe drought, with a need for double the normal rainfall to recover. The drought impacts water supply and requires urgent attention.

item.title: USDA requires milk testing to prevent bird flu spread - Valley News
item.description: Vermont tests milk from every dairy farm to prevent the spread of highly pathogenic avian influenza, ensuring safe practices and food supply.

item.title: Bear incidents on rise in Vermont, experts warn - Valley News
item.description: Learn how black bears in Vermont are attracted to birdfeeders and other backyard food sources, leading to increased bear incidents.
